verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jules has developer API documentation with request walkthroughs ("To send a message to the agent:", "approve the latest plan as follows"), but nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples. The probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, so static docs with snippets are adjacent material and do not satisfy an interactive, runnable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
